Founded on 1 November 1938, it plays in the [[Primeira Liga]], holding home games at [[Parque de Jogos Comendador Joaquim de Almeida Freitas]], with a capacity for 6,150 spectators.{{Cite web |title=Contactos |url=https://www.moreirensefc.pt/contactos/ |access-date=2025-03-12 |website=Moreirense Futebol Clube |language=pt-PT}} The team first played in the [[Liga Portugal 2|second tier]] in 1995 and the Primeira Liga in 2002. It won the [[Taça da Liga]] in [[2017 Taça da Liga final|2017]] and the second division championship in [[2013–14 Segunda Liga|2014]] and [[2022–23 Liga Portugal 2|2023]]."}}
